authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6261 *dādda explicitly gives Assamese/Bengali dādā elder brother and Nepali dājyu elder brother. Hajong dada and Nepali-area daju older-brother responses fit this kinship family, retaining source vowel length and loss of the palatal glide. Nursery formation and local Indo-Aryan transmission remain open; no single remote origin is asserted. Exact response: daju.
